site.calpers.ca.gov 2026 investment return fiscal year July 2026

sources_considered.why: Dated commentary from contributors to the Q3 Venture Monitor establishes continuing AI concentration and selective financing.
Primary pension disclosure provides realized-period investment context, with preliminary-result and valuation-lag limitations.
Official warning documents concern about AI investment exposure. UK scope and prospective risk make it context only.
Read in full, but the landing page gives no explicit publication date. The dated report-contributor summary is used instead.
read_page returned HTTP 403; search-result exposure figures were not admitted as evidence.

evidence_items.explanation: The report describes highly concentrated AI financing alongside difficulties for other startups. Concentration and selective access do not establish broad funding collapse after an AI bust, and a share alone does not measure total funding volume.

evidence_items.locator: Second body paragraph, discussing the preliminary annual investment return
evidence_items.explanation: CalPERS reported improving annual investment performance, rather than a realized annual pension loss in this period. One fund's pre-trigger results neither establish retirees' spending outcomes nor contradict an undated conditional forecast.

evidence_items.locator: Body paragraph following discussion of hidden AI-related exposure
evidence_items.explanation: The UK regulator issued guidance about hidden AI concentration risk, making the pension-risk concern material. This is official regulatory guidance rather than a statistical loss estimate, and it documents neither a US pension loss nor reduced retirement spending.

unresolved_gaps: An AI bubble collapse has not been established as the triggering event.
No post-trigger evidence establishes a severe, broad venture funding contraction.
No linked pension-loss and retirement-resource records establish the predicted transmission.
CalPERS results cover one fund, are preliminary, and include private-market valuations lagged by one quarter.
